answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The comet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the knoll. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the ripple of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
